correctness.rationale: The assigned RESULT.md constructs Krawtchouk eigenvalues from (1+(q-1)z)^(d-k)(1-z)^k, reducing unrestricted symmetric radius-two Hamming mixing by group averaging to two shell weights. Degree-one lambda_1 >=1-2q/[d(q-1)] with equality generically only at pure shell two; the quadratic completion-of-square bound F(d,q)>0 controls every negative Fourier eigenvalue. Signed positive dual combinations certify the d=3,q=3 and d=3,q=4 exceptions (SLEM 1/7). For all unrestricted generic optima, trace saturation of mI-P on degree-one harmonics and rowwise change count force zero holding and distance-one mass and each changed symbol marginal 2/[d(q-1)]. d=2 is complete graph with unique Pi. Independent Fraction computations checked 165 d,q cases. The derivation, not finite tests, covers every integer d>=2,q>=3.
